notes: 修复 0.3.77 两处显示问题：快速跳转标签顺序改为与卡片渲染顺序完全一致（含条件分区同步冲突/本机路径动态出现）；标题栏改不透明背景，滚动内容不再从标题背后透出，跳转按标题栏实际高度设落点，目标分区完整显示在标题下方。
notesEn: Two display fixes on top of 0.3.77: quick-jump tabs now follow the exact card render order (conditional Sync conflicts / Local paths sections appear only when their cards do); the sticky title bar uses an opaque background so content no longer shows through, and jumps set the scroll offset from the title bar height so the target section lands fully below it.
